title: OCP Metrics
description: Schema for the 'OCP' key inside the unified review-output metrics object.

value.description: OCP-1: count of DIRECT NON-INJECTED concrete dependencies (sealed points)

additional-info.description: Optional sealed_list: [string] — names of the sealed variation points

value.description: OCP-2: count of DIRECT/INDIRECT dependencies that cannot be substituted for testing
OCP-3: count of DIRECT INJECTED concrete dependencies that are testable (subclassable)
